title_original: Artificial Trailer: Andrew Garfield Shapes the Future in Luca Guadagnino’s Tech Horror Story

blocks.text: We’re now just about a month out from the horror film of the year. Luca Guadagnino’s Artificial , which stars Andrew Garfield as OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Yura Borisov as Co-founder Ilya Sutskever, premiered at New York Film Festival last month and will now arrive in theaters starting Christmas Day. With a cast including Monica Barbaro, Cooper Hoffman, Jason Schwartzman, Chris O’Dowd, Ike Barinholtz, and Mark Rylance, the new trailer has now arrived.

Here’s the synopsis: “From Luca Guadagnino comes the story of OpenAI and a two decade artificial intelligence arms race. When a computer scientist and AI pioneer Professor Geoffrey Hinton makes a breakthrough they are certain will alter humanity forever, Sam Altman, Elon Musk and the most prominent figures in Silicon Valley race to become part of their vision. As the technology becomes more powerful and more valuable than anyone ever imagined, a battle wages over who should control the tech that could change the fate of humanity.”

Luke Hicks said in our NYFF review , “There might be a successor to The Social Network arriving, but Artificial is the spiritual sequel that David Fincher’s lightning-in-a-bottle original deserves. It doesn’t hold a candle to Fincher’s edge for covering the tech industry, nor can it find the gripping dramatic angle that makes The Social Network so consequential for a wide audience. But it’s an original take on a similar concept: the unregulated, breakneck, real-time development of a technology that is unquestionably changing every aspect of our lives in unknown ways on a drastic scale every day for the foreseeable future. Where Fincher went for tech thriller, Guadagnino goes for stage play, leaving cinema’s most kinetic tricks behind.”
